reference_sql:
SELECT ol.product_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ol.promo_id IS NOT NULL THEN ol.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS promo_units,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ol.promo_id IS NULL THEN ol.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS full_price_units
FROM order_lines ol
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id
WHERE p.category_id = 16
  AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
GROUP BY ol.product_id
